verdict.rationale: Bento documents its own Python SDK with installation pages, `init()` configuration, `bento.track_ai` for wrapping LLM and tool calls, `bento.flush()`, and a Google ADK extra, so developers can build against an official SDK. The story asks for SDKs in the plural, but only Python is clearly shown: for TypeScript the docs recommend sending OpenTelemetry traces with no Bento package, and the OpenAPI probe found no API spec. missing for 10: an evidenced official SDK beyond Python (e.g. TypeScript/JS), a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: `init()` accepts `user_id`, `session_id`, and `tags` kwargs. Bento invokes them on every span
Wrap any LLM or tool call with bento.track_ai.
install the extra so Bento can capture every call automatically
